text:
maria-partnerships: Satya's HW marketplace asked whether to send minute-level events or hourly rollups; duplicates causing wrong billing. thoughts?

alex-platform: prefer hourly for bulk billing, minute only for real-time dashboards. need an explicit header so ingestion knows how to treat payloads.

tim-engr: agree. propose X-RW-Aggregation: none|minute|hour. require external_event_id for dedupe. fallback dedupe: device_id+timestamp.

jenna-fin: billing needs sku_breakdown or sku_key on every aggregated row. otherwise reconciliation fails. also a daily NDJSON totals feed for matching.

priya-sre: spike protection: 429 + Retry-After. we'll include X-Recommended-Batch-Size to guide partners downward.

maria-partnerships: what's our TTL for late events? partners have flaky device clocks.

tim-engr: default TTL 72h; events older -> 410 stale. allow partner override in agreements.

alex-platform: add sequence_number optional for ordering hints and source_region to route to ledger shard.

jenna-fin: reconciliation format: one gzipped NDJSON/day with lines like {"date":"2024-06-01","partner":"p-xyz","sku":"embed","units":3600}. include X-Canonical-SHA256 header (sha256 over canonical sorted lines).

priya-sre: we'll post daily ingest summaries via reconcile-bot so partners see rejects quickly.

reconcile-bot: Daily digest scheduled at 05:30 UTC: accepted_count, rejected_sample.ndjson.gz, top_error_codes.

maria-partnerships: action items: tim -> short contract example + curl, priya -> SLOs & rate numbers, jenna -> checksum canonicalization, alex -> test harness. I'll draft the partner note and share for review.

alex-platform: will include partial-accept example (202 with accepted_count and rejected list) to avoid blind retries.

maria-partnerships: thanks all, will publish once reviewed. :white_check_mark:
